title: Old Fashioned Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A traditional Kenyan lamb stew with a garlicky flavor, this dish is perfect for a cold monsoon day. It features tender lamb, crumbly texture, and a sugar-free friendly recipe.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the brine, tomato paste, beef broth, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots to the stew and continue to simmer, covered, for another 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
